baseline.answer:
Hello,

To request a Jira licence, please provide the following information:

- **User type:** Internal or External User
- **User requiring the licence:** Full name (and employee ID, if internal)
- **Application:** Jira
- **Project engagement:** Project name or engagement code
- **Jira project:** Project key and/or a link to an issue in the project
- **Justification:** Please confirm that access is required to view your tasks for the **CASSA CENTRALE** project

The Jira project key is the prefix in an issue identifier, formatted as `<Project_Key>-<number>`. You can find it in any Jira issue URL or Jira email notification. Please note that the Jira Service Management portal URL is not a valid project URL.

Once this information is provided, we can process the licence request.

✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software

- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your GHF employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accept persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: Marco Rizzi (Siena) (X91Z)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: GHF-DkWQO2nbFx9 (PC)

- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GHF & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:

- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
I need to install software and tools to be able to develop.
List:
IntelliJ
Java 17
DBeaver
Postman
SoapUI
other
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- GHF Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GHF Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GHF Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GHF Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GHF Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GHF Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GHF Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GHF Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GHF/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service

Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for harming the integrity of your working device, GFT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or stealing confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- Full name of your manager/approver at level L6 or above. If you are L6 or above, provide your own name.

- Operating system.
- Client(s) and project(s) you support.
- Detailed justification, including the complete list of software/actions requiring administrator rights (for example, Node.js and any related development tools).

Please also confirm with your manager that local administrator rights do not conflict with any client requirements. Permanent rights are intended only for recurring business needs; one-time installations should use temporary access where possible.

Any software installed must be approved for business use and comply with the LAR policy. Do not alter the base system installation or disable security services. Approved access must be renewed after 12 months.

- Destination DNS name: `abc.intranet.service`
- Destination port: `9443`

```text

Ti ricordiamo che hai la possibilità di riscattare il tuo vecchio PC. Per esercitare la prelazione è sufficiente confermarlo nel ticket, successivamente verrai contattato per eseguire una formattazione da remoto. Se ricevi una mail dove ti viene chiesto di restituire il vecchio, non preoccuparti puoi ignorarla. Il prezzo è di 60 € per PC e 160 € per MacOS. NOTE: Ricorda che la prelazione è valida se: Entro 7 giorni dalla data di creazione del presente ticket eserciti il tuo diritto di prelazione. Il vecchio PC viene formattato/riconsegnato all'ufficio IT entro e non oltre 30 giorni dalla data di ritiro del nuovo device. To process a local administrator rights request, please provide the following information:

- Full name of your DPQ employee manager (L6 or above) for approval. If you are L6 or above, provide your own name.
- Computer name (Device Name in the Company Portal, or run `hostname` in Command Prompt).
- Confirmation that the request is for a Windows computer.
- List of clients/projects you support.
- Justification and the specific actions requiring administrator rights (for example: NVM, Node.js, and environment-variable changes).

Please select **Short Term** rights only if Group IT cannot perform the task. If this is required for a one-time installation, please use **Windows Software Installation – I need software or a license installed on my computer** instead.

Please note that administrator access is subject to approval, carries security risks, and must be renewed after 12 months if still required.

✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies.

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e. viruses and malware).
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GFT/

✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

? Alter the base GFB Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GFB/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base ABC Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the ABC/IT Infrastructure

Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, ZYX & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

- ZYX Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base ZYX Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the ZYX Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from ZYX Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of ZYX Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between ZYX Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a ZYX Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base ZYX Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the ZYX/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

- You are also responsible for providing a patch management process for the software that you additionally installed
